known_issues.issue: The egg grader and the egg sorter are drawn as the same machine and both claim tracker 19.
known_issues.action: Grader is canonical for now. Sorter is kept as 19b-egg-sorter until 25TH picks one. Neither is dropped.

known_issues.issue: The sheets used a 256 x 341.333 cell, so frame edges fell between pixels.
known_issues.action: Fixed: Spawn commit 62432a9 rebuilt them on whole-pixel 256 x 384 cells (1024 x 1152 sheets, same rows and timings). The new sheets are in art/13-sack-*; the old ones are kept as unmapped/art/13-sack-*-fractional-cell.png.

known_issues.status: gapless OGGs built headlessly, ear check pending
known_issues.issue: Spawn holds MP3 only, with no WAV or OGG masters. MP3 pads the start and end of each file, so looping sounds will gap at the loop point.
known_issues.action: Each looping sound now has a gapless <take>-loop.ogg (OGG Vorbis quality 6) built here from its MP3: gapless decode, silence trim, zero-crossing snap, and a crossfade of 10 ms or less where the seam still jumped. sound.json "loop" gives the loop points. An ear check is pending; listen to audio/05-snore first (its OGG seam step is 1.4 times the natural step nearby, about -40 dBFS). Masters from the original source would still beat a re-encode of an MP3.

known_issues.issue: Spawn's timings.md lists a 600 ms hold on the last frame. easels.json plays 60 ms frames, then removes the particle.
known_issues.action: easels.json is the source of truth and anim.json follows it. The 600 ms hold in timings.md is outdated.
